answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to stake a small, time-locked deposit before transacting, with the stake growing as the agent earns reputation — like a reef that only a committed builder can anchor to. New identities start with near-zero trust and must earn standing through verified work, so spinning up thousands of fake agents costs real capital. Independent auditors act as a bridge between reputation registries, letting honest history travel across platforms, while a saffron-flagged identity caught gaming the system loses its stake and standing everywhere at once.
